# Scripts & Justfile Reference

This project ships **`scripts/*.sh`** for every common chore and a top-level
**`Justfile`** that wraps them with friendly names. Always prefer `just <recipe>`
over invoking scripts directly — it makes intent obvious in shell history.

## Decision table — pick the right script

| User intent | `just` recipe | Script |
|---|---|---|
| Fresh clone, install everything | `just bootstrap` | `scripts/bootstrap.sh` |
| Start the full local stack | `just dev` | `scripts/dev.sh` |
| Bring stack up detached | `just up` | `docker compose up -d --build` |
| Stop stack (keep data) | `just down` | `docker compose down` |
| Wipe stack + database volume | `just down-hard` | `docker compose down -v` |
| Tail logs | `just logs [service]` | `docker compose logs -f` |
| psql shell | `just psql` | `docker compose exec db psql ...` |
| Run all tests | `just test` | `scripts/test.sh` |
| Backend tests only | `just test-backend` | `cd backend && uv run pytest` |
| Frontend tests (watch) | `just test-watch` | `cd frontend && pnpm test:watch` |
| Lint everything | `just lint` | `scripts/lint.sh` |
| Auto-format everything | `just format` | `scripts/format.sh` |
| Run security audit | `just audit` | `scripts/audit.sh` |
| Audit, fail on moderate+ | `just audit-strict` | `AUDIT_STRICT=1 scripts/audit.sh` |
| Regenerate backend+frontend from OpenAPI | `just generate` | `scripts/generate.sh` |
| Preview what generate would change | `just generate-dry` | `scripts/generate.sh --dry-run` |
| Apply pending migrations | `just migrate` | `scripts/migrate.sh upgrade` |
| New autogenerated migration | `just migrate-new "msg"` | `scripts/migrate.sh new "msg"` |
| Roll back one migration | `just migrate-down` | `scripts/migrate.sh downgrade` |
| Scaffold a new domain | `just new-domain NAME` | `scripts/new-domain.sh NAME` |
| Context snapshot for an LLM | `just ctx` | `scripts/agent-context.sh` |
| Clean caches & build artefacts | `just clean` | `scripts/clean.sh` |
| Clean + drop generated client | `just clean-hard` | `scripts/clean.sh --hard` |

## Rules

- Run from the **repo root** — Justfile resolves paths relative to it.
- `just` auto-loads `.env` (via `set dotenv-load`). Do not export vars manually
  unless overriding for a single run.
- For destructive recipes (`down-hard`, `clean-hard`, `migrate-down`) always
  confirm with the user before running.
- If `just` is missing, instruct the user: `sudo apt install just` or
  `cargo install just`. Fall back to running `scripts/<x>.sh` directly.

## Common pitfalls

- **`just generate` produces a giant diff** → that's expected; `api/openapi.yaml`
  is the source of truth. Commit the regenerated files alongside the spec change.
- **`just migrate` says "Target database is not up to date"** → run
  `just migrate-history` to inspect; you may have local revisions ahead of the
  branch HEAD.
- **`just dev` fails with `POSTGRES_PASSWORD required`** → user has not copied
  `.env.example` to `.env`. Tell them: `cp .env.example .env && edit .env`.
